value.name: Asha greets Devin at the door
value.description: Asha arrives at Devin's apartment entrance and greets him while presenting the page she brought.
evidence: met his eyes, and said, "Hello, Devin. I brought you the page."

value.name: Devin silently lets Asha inside
value.description: Devin steps back from the threshold and gestures her into the apartment without speaking.
evidence: He stepped back from the threshold without answering and tipped his head toward the kitchen behind him, and she crossed in over the mat

value.name: Asha enters feeling she must be more honest
value.description: As she goes inside, Asha realizes her next words will need to be more honest than her greeting.
evidence: aware that the next thing she said in his apartment would have to be more honest than the first

value.name: Asha and Devin face each other in the kitchen
value.description: Inside the narrow kitchen, Devin clears space and waits while Asha prepares to hand over the corrected filing.
evidence: The kitchen was narrower than she'd pictured, a galley with a small square table pushed against the wall under a hanging lamp, two mismatched chairs, a half-folded laundry basket on one of them.
Devin moved the basket onto the counter without a word and dropped the dish towel beside the sink, then stood with his hands at his sides, waiting.

value.name: Asha delays while opening the briefcase
value.description: Asha sets down her briefcase and slowly opens it, resisting the urge to talk while her hands are occupied.
evidence: Asha set the briefcase flat on the table and worked the latches one at a time, slower than she needed to, because she could feel herself wanting to talk while her hands were busy and she had decided in the car not to do that.

value.name: Asha presents the corrected filing
value.description: Asha removes the corrected filing from the briefcase and places it on the table between them with Devin's name visible.
evidence: She lifted the corrected filing out by its edges and laid it on the table between them, the signature block turned so he could read his own name where hers would normally have been.

value.name: Asha hesitates after placing the page
value.description: Asha keeps her fingers on the page briefly, signaling reluctance or the need to say more before withdrawing.
